import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import zipfile
import shutil

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_updated.xlsx'
NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

def q(tag):
    return f'{{{NS}}}{tag}'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')
entries = {name: zin.read(name) for name in zin.namelist()}
zin.close()

# ---- Modify sheet1.xml ----
root = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])

dim = root.find(q('dimension'))
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

cols = root.find(q('cols'))
new_col = ET.SubElement(cols, q('col'))
new_col.set('width', '12')
new_col.set('customWidth', '1')
new_col.set('min', '8')
new_col.set('max', '8')
cols[:] = sorted(cols, key=lambda c: int(c.get('min')))

sheet_data = root.find(q('sheetData'))
rows = {int(r.get('r')): r for r in sheet_data.findall(q('row'))}

h1 = ET.SubElement(rows[1], q('c'))
h1.set('r', 'H1')
h1.set('s', '1')
h1.set('t', 'inlineStr')
is_el = ET.SubElement(h1, q('is'))
t_el = ET.SubElement(is_el, q('t'))
t_el.text = 'Profit Margin'

for r in range(2, 10):
    cell = ET.SubElement(rows[r], q('c'))
    cell.set('r', f'H{r}')
    cell.set('s', '3')
    f_el = ET.SubElement(cell, q('f'))
    f_el.text = f'G{r}/E{r}'
    ET.SubElement(cell, q('v'))

cell10 = ET.SubElement(rows[10], q('c'))
cell10.set('r', 'H10')
cell10.set('s', '4')
f10 = ET.SubElement(cell10, q('f'))
f10.text = 'G10/E10'
ET.SubElement(cell10, q('v'))

def col_key(cell):
    ref = cell.get('r', '')
    return ''.join(ch for ch in ref if ch.isalpha())
for r in rows.values():
    r[:] = sorted(r, key=col_key)

entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = ET.tostring(root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

# ---- Modify styles.xml ----
sroot = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/styles.xml'])

numfmts = sroot.find(q('numFmts'))
numfmts.set('count', '1')
fmt = ET.SubElement(numfmts, q('numFmt'))
fmt.set('numFmtId', '164')
fmt.set('formatCode', '0.0%')

cellxfs = sroot.find(q('cellXfs'))
for xf_attrs in [
    {'numFmtId': '164', 'fontId': '0', 'fillId': '0', 'borderId': '0', 'pivotButton': '0', 'quotePrefix': '0', 'xfId': '0'},
    {'numFmtId': '164', 'fontId': '1', 'fillId': '0', 'borderId': '0', 'pivotButton': '0', 'quotePrefix': '0', 'xfId': '0'},
]:
    xf = ET.SubElement(cellxfs, q('xf'))
    for k, v in xf_attrs.items():
        xf.set(k, v)
cellxfs.set('count', str(len(cellxfs)))

entries['xl/styles.xml'] = ET.tostring(sroot, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        zout.writestr(name, data)

shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print('Done. Updated', SRC)
PYEOF
